request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Replace the one big red rocket with a tight roped bundle of four small paper fireworks rockets on thin sticks: paper tubes in grubby red, orange, yellow and blue, each with a cream paper cone tip and a small star, one fuse lit with a small spark. The cart becomes rickety dull dark brown planks (#5c3a22, shadows #3a2414) with dark brown wooden wheels. Keep the size, the cart's shape, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
